plainText:
Makoto Higo (Japanese: 肥後誠 Higo Makoto) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Higo was born on June 1, 1971, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided the voice of Kai, one of the Invincible Pokémon Brothers, during , as well as Pokémon Chronicles. He then provided a couple more voices during , most notably that of Sid in the seventh movie. Higo was affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production, but is now with KeKKe Corporation.
